text: ok i just painted some and they still are not showing up
resolution: FIXED (c87a7a423). User painted palm tiles and saw nothing. Traced end-to-end: NOT a path bug — data correct (live session scan: palm tile index 26, 25 cells painted in the 3 active chunks; grass/bush populate through the identical floor→landform→eachPaintedCell walk). Root cause was sparsity: cellChance 0.06 (~1 palm/16 cells) over 25 cells expects ~1.5 and hits exactly 0 ~21% of the time — confirmed buildPalmInstances returned 0 on the real map. Raised to 0.22 → same patch now bakes 10 palms / 234 fronds (verified live), a visible grove, while big fields stay scattered. '3 vs 9 chunks' was the user toggling 6 off, not a bug. Action: recompile to see the grove.
